mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCdBuyerCardInfoPopList*/ SELECT COM_CODE, COM_NAME_LOC, INDUSTRY_TYPE, ADDRESS_LOC, TEL_NO, NOTE, BUSINESS_ITEMS FROM ( SELECT A.COM_CODE, GETCMSLOCNAME(A.COM_CODE, B.SITE) AS COM_NAME_LOC, A.INDUSTRY_TYPE AS INDUSTRY_TYPE, '['||A.ZIP_CODE||'] '|| A.ADDRESS_LOC AS ADDRESS_LOC, A.TEL_NO, B.NOTE, A.BUSINESS_ITEMS AS BUSINESS_ITEMS FROM ICOMCMPY A, KEP_VISITHD B WHERE A.COM_CODE = B.BUYER AND A.COM_CODE = #{com_code} AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.STATUS != 'D' UNION ALL SELECT A.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO AS COM_CODE, GETCMSLOCNAME(A.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO, C.SITE) AS COM_NAME_LOC, B.ITM_NM AS INDUSTRY_TYPE, '['||B.BIZNPLC_POSTCD||'] '|| B.BIZNPLC_ADDR_BSC ||' '||BIZNPLC_ADDR_DTAIL AS ADDRESS_LOC, B.RPRSNT_PHON_NO AS TEL_NO, C.NOTE, B.BIZCND_NM AS BUSINESS_ITEMS FROM KEPMDCP02 A, KEPMDCP01 B, KEP_VISITHD C WHERE A.CSTMR_ID = B.ALANC_ID AND A.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO = C.BUYER AND A.ALANC_CLSS_CD = 'C002' AND A.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO = #{com_code} AND A.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND B.USE_CHK = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT A.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO AS COM_CODE, GETCMSLOCNAME(A.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO, C.SITE) AS COM_NAME_LOC, B.ITM_NM AS INDUSTRY_TYPE, '['||B.BIZNPLC_POSTCD||'] '|| B.BIZNPLC_ADDR_BSC ||' '||BIZNPLC_ADDR_DTAIL AS ADDRESS_LOC, B.RPRSNT_PHON_NO AS TEL_NO, C.NOTE, B.BIZCND_NM AS BUSINESS_ITEMS FROM KEPMDCP03@kepcon A, KEPMDCP01 B, KEP_VISITHD C WHERE A.CSTMR_ID = B.ALANC_ID AND A.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO = C.BUYER AND A.BIZNPLC_CLSS_NO = #{com_code} AND A.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND B.USE_CHK = 'Y' ) X WHERE COM_CODE IS NOT NULL

/* selectMasterMdCdBuyerCardInfoPopAcount */ SELECT X.COM_CODE ,X.YYYY||'년 (백만원)' AS YYYY ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_1)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_1 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_2)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_2 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_3)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_3 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_4)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_4 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_5)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_5 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_6)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_6 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_7)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_7 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_8)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_8 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_9)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_9 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_10)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_10 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_11)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_11 ,NVL(TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_12)/1000000,0),0) AS MON_12 ,NVL( TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_1)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_2)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_3)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_4)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_5)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_6)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_7)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_8)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_9)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_10)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_11)/1000000,0)+TRUNC(SUM(X.MON_12)/1000000,0),0) AS SUM_AMT FROM ( SELECT COM_CODE ,SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,0,4) AS YYYY ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '01', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_1 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '02', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_2 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '03', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_3 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '04', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_4 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '05', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_5 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '06', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_6 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '07', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_7 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '08', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_8 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '09', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_9 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '10', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_10 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '11', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_11 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '12', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_12 FROM KEP_AMOUNT_MNG WHERE 1=1 AND COM_CODE = #{com_code} AND SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,0,4) =TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') UNION ALL SELECT COM_CODE ,SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,0,4) AS YYYY ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '01', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_1 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '02', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_2 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '03', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_3 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '04', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_4 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '05', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_5 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '06', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_6 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '07', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_7 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '08', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_8 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '09', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_9 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '10', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_10 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '11', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_11 ,DECODE(SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) , '12', ITEM_AMT, 0) AS MON_12 FROM KEP_AMOUNT_MNG WHERE 1=1 AND COM_CODE = #{com_code} AND SUBSTR(CLOSE_MONTH,0,4) =TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')-1 ) X GROUP BY X.COM_CODE, X.YYYY ORDER BY X.YYYY ASC

/* selectMasterMdCdBuyerCardInfoPopVisit */ SELECT BUYER ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,VISIT_DATE ,VISIT_TIME ,STATUS ,VISIT_TYPE ,SUBSTR(VISIT_NOTE ,0,50) AS VISIT_NOTE ,IMAGE_KEY ,DECODE(IMAGE_KEY, NULL, '0', '1') AS IMAGE_FLAG ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(VISIT_DATE || VISIT_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CSTMR_VISIT_DATE ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 CD WHERE CD.TYPE = 'K003' AND CD.CODE = DT.VISIT_TYPE ) AS VISIT_TYPE_NM ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 CD WHERE CD.TYPE = 'CP15' AND CD.CODE = DT.VISIT_TYPE ) AS VISIT_MDCT_NM ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_USER_DEPT ,(SELECT A.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR A WHERE A.USER_ID = DT.ADD_USER_ID ) AS USER_NAME_LOC ,SUBSTR(VISIT_NOTE,0,INSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(VISIT_NOTE,CHR(13),''), CHR(10),'PWDENTTER##!!'),'PWDENTTER##!!')) AS VISIT_NOTE_TITLE FROM KEP_VISITDT DT WHERE 1=1 AND BUYER = #{com_code} AND STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY VISIT_DATE DESC
